entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: A man from Shingol in Terisiare's Dark Age, heir to the throne of Iwset and wearer of the Living Armor.

entities.name: Lady Pioni
entities.description: Yunnie's mother and Lord Peemel's wife, killed by him.

entities.name: Lord Peemel
entities.description: Husband of Pioni who had her killed for her money.

entities.name: Tavora
entities.description: Elf who brought Yunnie to Shingol.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Minotaur Yunnie views as a blood-brother, killed by Tiyint.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A blood witch who deceives Yunnie and starts a war, killed later.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Saves Yunnie from a jump and accompanies him.

entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: Dies at the cost of killing Sacumon.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: Giant statue of a legendary Urhaalan hero, awakened by Mytaru.

entities.name: Lady Edara
entities.description: Lady of Jehesic proposed as Yunnie's bride.

entities.name: Living Armor
entities.description: Armor that drains its wearer's vitality and preserves itself.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: Sigil found under Yunnie's house, smashed by him.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest home of elves at war with the Urhaalan.

events.summary: Lord Peemel has his wife Pioni killed; Tavora takes the infant Yunnie to Shingol to be adopted.
events.quote: The elf Tavora then brought Yunnie to Shingol

events.summary: Sacumon deceives Yunnie, giving him the Living Armor and silencing him with spells.
events.quote: cast spells of Amnesia and Silence upon him

events.summary: Sacumon starts a war between the Urhaalan and the Eln Forest elves.
events.quote: Sacumon then orchestrated a war between the Urhaalan and the elves of Eln Forest

events.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh saves Yunnie from jumping at Merfolk Vista.
events.quote: Saved by Maeveen O'Donagh at the last second

events.summary: Sacumon is killed at the cost of Coernn's life.
events.quote: Sacumon could not stand against the assault and was killed at the cost of Coernn's life

events.summary: Mytaru wears the Living Armor to fight Tiyint; the two die together.
events.quote: Tiyint crushing Mytaru in its stone hands even as the artifact's magic caused the statue to deactivate

events.summary: Yunnie refuses a marriage alliance, smashes the Sigil of Iwset and abandons the city.
events.quote: Yunnie refused, smashing the sigil and abandoning the city to its fate

relations.quote: Yunnie was the son of Vervamon and Lady Pioni
He befriended Mytaru and eventually came to view him as a brother.
